review: The government report identifies Barangay Caliling in Cauayan, Negros Occidental in July 2021. EO 38 restored Negros Occidental to Region VI upon newspaper publication in August 2017; Western Visayas is Region VI. This is a membership observation, not an uninterrupted interval or an assertion of the exact 2024 transition date. Wikidata Q31528302 identifies Caliling (GeoNames 1709625); an index row lacking that ID needs the exact named Cauayan and Negros Occidental identity chain. The existing indexed Kaliling spelling is not added by this record.
